title: Minimum DNF width
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, define its DNF width to be the infimum of the natural numbers $w$ for which $f$ has a DNF of width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The predicate HasDNFWidthLE, which determines admissible widths, is not defined in the supplied snippet.
